pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Librería ficticia para una demostración funcional de consulta bibliográfica e inventario compartido. Su identidad editorial ayuda a encontrar y mantener libros sin simular una tienda real ni ofrecer compras.

pages.summary: Express a bibliographic catalog and shared inventory workspace, not a storefront. Let navigation, records and editing define the identity before any decorative element.

pages.summary: Describe the supplied project purpose instead of inventing corporate vision or mission. Frame consultation, editing and inventory reading as three connected tasks.

pages.title: Design principles
pages.summary: Translate the brief into observable design principles: continuity, legibility and honest state language. These are project rules, not claims about a real business's values.

examples.text: In Administrar libros, keep the selected title, state and Guardar action on the same upper edge.

examples.text: Use Precio pendiente for an unknown price and Resultado sin confirmar for an uncertain save.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write all interface copy in direct Spanish. Name the action or problem, then the next step. Avoid sales language, invented currency and claims of private access.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The symbol uses mirrored curved pages and a central spine. Pair it with the separately typeset name; the page curves must remain visible at every intended size.

examples.text: Keep the name unbroken above the three visible navigation links. Do not replace it with initials.

pages.summary: Keep clear space equal to one quarter of the symbol's canvas width around the complete lockup. Nearby rules, navigation and support-surface edges must respect this zone.

examples.text: Reserve at least 10 px outside the Librería Brisa lockup; the internal symbol-to-name gap remains 16 px.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Use Tinta for the original symbol on Papel, Hoja or Selección. On a Tinta field, preserve the symbol geometry and color by adding a cream support surface.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the original 160 × 160 open-book geometry as the single symbol source. Its layered pages imply an editorial spread without adding letters, wind lines or a enclosing badge.

examples.text: Use the book alone for the app icon; retain Librería Brisa as its accessible application name.

examples.text: Derive 16, 32 and 48 px icon assets from the same geometry. Do not create a separate favicon drawing.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline or decorate the symbol. Preserve the accent in Librería and the full business name. Keep the mark separate from interface status indicators.

examples.text: Do not shorten the name to Brisa, replace it with LB or set Librería Brisa in decorative italics.
examples.title: Incorrect signature

examples.text: Do not recolor the book in Error red after a failed save or place the ink symbol directly on the ink cover.
examples.title: Incorrect treatment

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce the type system with an editorial heading and a practical supporting line. Use Source Serif 4 for identity and titles, Source Sans 3 for interface reading.

examples.text: Consulta títulos, autores y categorías sin perder el contexto.
examples.title: Libros, en una hoja continua

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Keep the serif/sans division consistent: serif establishes the page and book identity; sans handles actions, fields, states and figures. Avoid a third expressive family.

examples.text: Busca por título o autor y filtra por categoría.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Use Source Serif 4 for the name and editorial headings, with 32–48 px page titles. Allow long bibliographic titles to wrap naturally rather than reducing them to tiny type.

examples.text: Use upright 600 for Librería Brisa and page headings. Keep essential book titles complete, even when they occupy two lines.
examples.title: Title setting

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use serif 600 for the brand and headings; sans 400 for reading, 500 for labels and 600 for actions. Do not apply the renderer's 700 default to the identity. Avoid decorative capitals and italics.

examples.text: Revisa título, autor, categoría, precio y stock antes de guardar.

examples.text: Cambios sin guardar uses sans 600; its explanation uses 400. Keep both upright and in Tinta rather than using italic emphasis.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 at 16 px for controls and body copy, 14 px for secondary information. Supplied font files are available; host both families locally and preserve their licenses.

examples.text: Introduce un precio válido para guardar este libro.

examples.text: Use tabular numerals for 35 and 0,00. If local fonts cannot load, use serif/sans-serif fallbacks; these are not the intended brand typefaces.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Build hierarchy through size, weight and spacing, not faded text. Use 32–48 px page titles, 22–24 px record titles, 16 px interface text and 14 px notes.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use the continuous editorial sheet: header, title, control border, then content. Space in 8/16/24/32/48 px steps. Avoid heroes, repeated cards and oversized metric panels.

examples.text: Use two catalog columns at 1440 px and one at 768/390 px. At 390 × 667, budget about 104/64/120 px for header, title and filters.

pages.summary: Introduce cream and ink as the dominant pairing. Use Selección as a quiet divider field, with a small ink marker linking the chapter heading to its supporting line.

pages.summary: Preserve every supplied hex value. Papel and Hoja form the canvas; Selección marks active surfaces. Both text roles use Tinta, distinguished by typography rather than opacity.

pages.summary: Use the supplied Selección as the active tint; do not create pale text by reducing ink opacity. Pair fields with ink borders that reach at least 3:1 against their surface.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Build recognition with shared rules, the spine-like separator and the blue route marker. Keep rules aligned to content edges; use 8 px radii only where controls need containment.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple ink interface icons with consistent stroke weight and visible text labels for key actions. Give every interactive target at least 44 px; the brand book is not a generic action icon.

examples.text: Pair a magnifier with Buscar por título o autor. Keep the permanent label even when the field is empty.

examples.text: Pair an error icon with Introduce un stock entero de 0 a 2147483647; never signal invalid stock with red alone.

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photographs, generated book covers or image placeholders. Bibliographic text, rules and useful whitespace provide the visual rhythm and avoid suggesting real stock imagery.

pages.summary: Use a typographic moodboard of cream paper, ink rules, curved page geometry and compact figures. Choose the editorial spread over illustrated shelves or repetitive bibliographic cards.

brandbook.voice: Español editorial, sencillo y práctico. Acciones explícitas, estados honestos y mensajes breves. Una nota de demostración por página; sin reclamos comerciales, moneda inventada ni promesas de privacidad en la administración compartida.
